# nlohmann/json (vendored)

`json.hpp` is nlohmann/json **3.11.3**, single header, unmodified, MIT licence (`LICENSES/MIT.txt`).
Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.11.3 — SHA-256 `9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6`
(the release asset and `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp` at the tag are byte for byte identical).

It is used only inside pxs-core's sources (`src/tree_oscquery.cpp`, `src/tree_preset.cpp`); no public header includes it. To update:
download the new release, check it the same way, replace the file and this note, run the tests.
